request.reason: To tell which consumer bindings are observed at runtime (q3) I need every consumer group on Redpanda (rpk group list, then rpk group describe for each), with its topics, members and lag. I care most about the groups on catalog.product.events, catalog.category.events, catalog.attribute.events and tenant.tenant.events. Please also include rpk topic list, so I can see whether DLQ topics or other catalog.* topics exist.

Source evidence for which catalog topics (and which consumer group) the category query service consumes. The docs only say 'product and category events'.
To confirm tenant-service is the only producer of tenant.tenant.events, and to check whether it consumes or produces any catalog.* topic. Either would change the mirror directions.
